name: Vault Maintenance
summary: Keeps the vault current: files new intake into the right PARA folder, folds yesterday's daily log into MEMORY.md, and grows the wiki.
notes: Runs in the 21:30 evening window, after the day ends, so the daily log this team reflects on is complete. The hour lives in .claude/agents/day-schedule.json.

This team is the answer to 'keep the VAULT at its most up-to-date state at all times'. It owns the four capabilities that already existed before teams were introduced, plus echo.check, the no-op diagnostic used to prove the dispatcher is alive.
triage.classify runs on ollama and is marked private: intake demonstrably mixes in immigration and third-party material, so it is never routed to a cloud model.
memory.reflect keeps its once-per-calendar-day guard. Repeated runs on the same day are skipped rather than re-spending.

Shares the Housekeeping room with Sable (security) on /teams since 2026-09-22 ('room' field). The room is presentation only: the two teams keep separate manifests, producers, cadences and review rules, because Vera handles private vault content locally and auto-files, while Sable audits code read-only on codex and every finding is review-gated.
